'''Nannat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on [[Thaere Privo]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Nannat was the child of two soldiers in the [[Thaereian military]] and she was orphaned when they were killed in action. When she was 15, she was appointed to be the nanny of [[Night Forael Wren]], the daughter of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]], who had been kidnapped by the Thaereian military. Nannat cared for her for a year and during that time, she came to care very much for Night and almost considered her to be her little sister.
